items.prompt:
Refine THIS EXACT selected SPRING MOTORCYCLE illustration. It is the edit target and sole composition authority. Preserve its landscape framing, close side-view crop of motorcycle with front wheel cut at left, the woman seated at center-right, existing raised knee, boot beside fuel tank, descending other leg cropped below, hands at her clothing, torso lean, head angle, round low sunglasses, silver high ponytail and blue bow, blue oversized rolled-sleeve shirt, black shorts and boots, and all main motorcycle, cherry canopy, tree and walkway positions. The request is LESS UNNECESSARY DETAIL and GREATER CLARITY, while retaining refined Arknights-style painterly anime art.
FACE: refine the existing face without redesign: clean cyan irises, clear upper eyelids, readable eyebrows, economical small nose and confident smile with one small fang. Remove tiny cheek/eye scribbles and overlapping stray lines. Keep face and eyes crisp and readable above the existing low sunglasses. No oversharpening halos.

Make the major ponytail flow and shirt weight/tension clear. Keep opaque hand-painted layered strokes, varied hard/soft edges, a few selective fine strands, coherent lighting. Do not smooth to glossy plastic, vector flats or unfocused blur.

MOTORCYCLE: simplify redundant chrome glare, incoherent micro-lines and repeated scratches. Retain functional recognizable handlebars, mirror, tank, engine fins, exhaust, wheels, spokes and suspension in EXACT existing positions, but group mechanical details into clean readable structures and broader material reflections. No invented extra cables, bolts or decorative labels. Preserve a believable machine.
BACKGROUND: group cherry blossoms, foliage, petals and paving texture into calmer painted masses, with selected blossoms in focus near canopy and subdued distant scenery. Preserve the same pink/green/blue spring palette, daylight and existing branch arrangement. Reduce all-over speckle rather than adding Gaussian blur. The person and nearby main motorcycle edges should read crisply against a quieter background. High-quality full-resolution finished illustration, no text, watermark or border.
